summary: Enhance your IT auditing skills with our comprehensive compliance training. Stay up-to-date with industry standards and regulations. Join us today!
lede: The course uses ISO 19011, COSO Internal Control principles, COBIT, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 control themes, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 as reference points. Practical exercises cover access and change-management evidence, finding ratings, Excel-based workpapers, a Power BI dashboard concept, and management-ready remediation roadmaps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, operate, monitor, or report technology controls and need a structured foundation in IT auditing and compliance.
modules: IT Risk Assessment and Control Mapping
prerequisites: You need basic familiarity with organizational processes, IT service delivery, or information security controls. You do not need prior audit certification or programming skills. Bring a laptop if you want to adapt the Excel workpapers and reporting templates during practice. Any organizational examples used in exercises should be anonymized.
